decision_reason: Both Ensembl 115 OR8G3 transcripts (ENST00000641572, ENST00000641848) start with GTG, so the ordered protein begins Val. Replacing codon 1 with ATG gives the reviewed UniProt sequence P0DMU2 residue for residue. Same remedy Becca approved for SLC22A17 and TRPV6 on 2026-11-12 (reference_changes.tsv); the non-ATG adjudication found no start-supported alternative transcript. Sources: UniProt P0DMU2; Ensembl 115 ENST00000641572, ENST00000641848; non_atg_alternative_adjudication.tsv; l1_proteoform_decisions.tsv at commit 8fbcd342 (PR #300; also processed://sprint4/s4e9-orf-design-fg-panel/l1_proteoform_decisions.tsv), sha256 70463621305ceb1aae0757df23fc81e5f5781363b4f5d094028de85bbf471e64
